_paths_comment: Portable paths: ${HOUFIN_DATA}/${HOUFIN_PROCESSED} expand at load (src/config_utils.py; default <repo>/data and <repo>/data/processed locally, override via env on HPC). NOTE: raw_z_dir and path_features.output_dir are the SAME directory and must be kept in sync by hand -- generate_all_path_features writes the latter, model_inputs reads the former (they consume the encoder cube + BBS produced upstream).
_disease_arrival_map_comment: Per-pixel first-affected-breeding-season for House Finch mycoplasmal conjunctivitis, on the model grid. Built by scripts/build_disease_arrival_map.py from the documented 1994-2006 spread history (there is no published raster). Consumed by model_inputs.py as the onset gate for the K depression -- see src/model/age_fields.py.

kernel_contract._comment: The encoder supplies an uncentered 64-D Nyström feature map; model ingestion explicitly retains the first latent_dim (24) eigenfeatures to fit VRAM. Conditional on each w_scale, iid coefficients over those retained features imply Cov[H(x),H(x')|w_scale] = w_scale^2 Z_r(x)·Z_r(x'), the configured rank-r approximation to the original Ružička kernel. Truncation must be config-driven and recorded, never silent.

dispersal._comment: Single source of truth shared by Z_disp preparation and the forward model; resolved in exactly one place, build_kernels.dispersal_spec. Do not duplicate these boundaries in code.
dispersal._radial_splits_comment: juvenile_radial_splits_km takes either an explicit list of km boundaries (start 0.0, end >=1e8) or the string "derive" for equal-mass radial bands. The pinned literals are NOT quantiles of the current kernel. See docs/PRIORS.md#radial-splits.
dispersal._path_comment: Z_disp is intentionally a land-conditioned neighborhood/path summary: at each fractional displacement, water/nodata is excluded and the remaining land contribution is normalized. It is not a literal trajectory hazard through water.

age_structure_prior._comment: Resolution-invariant weak local-age-structure regularizer. We average log Beta density over land cell-years, then multiply by effective_sites, instead of treating every grid cell/year as an independent prior observation. This is a distributional belief about a representative local cell, not a prior on the domain-wide mean.

population_model._comment: Mechanistic/data-scale constants persisted into model-input metadata; no hidden grid or invasion constants in ingestion code.
population_model._scale_comment: THE GAUGE: population_scale_route_counts_per_relative_unit converts model density to the mean of a BBS route count. A sampler-conditioning choice, not biology -- the likelihood is invariant to it. See docs/PRIORS.md#the-gauge.
population_model._disease_prior_comment: The mycoplasmal-conjunctivitis effect on capacity, as a STRUCTURED hypothesis: K = K_base * (1 - severity(x) * onset_gate(x,t) * (1 - recovery(t - arrival))). See docs/PRIORS.md#disease-term and src/model/age_fields.py.
population_model._capacity_level_comment: Prior on K's continental LEVEL, in expected BBS route counts, anchored on the typical OCCUPIED cell (median 2.618). See docs/PRIORS.md#capacity-level.
population_model._allee_comment: Allee half-saturation on the BBS ROUTE-COUNT scale: allee_factor = 1 - 2^(-C/n50), half released at C = n50. See docs/PRIORS.md#allee-effect.
population_model._initpop_comment: The t=0 (1902) native-range seed, as a FRACTION OF LOCAL FITTED CAPACITY rather than an absolute abundance. Read the consequence of core_fraction_of_local_capacity = 1.0 before changing it. See docs/PRIORS.md#initial-population.
population_model._invasion_pulse_comment: The 1940 release, as a fraction of a FIXED, empirically observed, K-independent reference -- deliberately not tied to k_level or local K_base. See docs/PRIORS.md#invasion-pulse.
population_model._invasion_sites_comment: invasion_sites = 9: the record documents one known sighting, not that it was the only release, and at 27 km the literal coordinate may not land on a valid cell. See docs/PRIORS.md#invasion-sites.
population_model._invasion_budget_comment: With 90 free (site, year) coefficients the SHARED prior must tighten, or the term becomes a high-dimensional escape hatch. See docs/PRIORS.md#invasion-budget.

capacity_level_prior._link_comment: K uses a SOFTPLUS link applied in DENSITY space: K = softplus(alpha_k + gamma_k*H_k + trend), no gauge conversion around it. See docs/PRIORS.md#capacity-link.
capacity_level_prior._calibration_comment: target_level_median_route_counts is the belief; alpha_k's prior LOCATION is solved from it at import by age_priors._softplus_loc_for_median. See docs/PRIORS.md#capacity-calibration.

population_model._manifold_comment: Correlated weights for FOUR demographic manifolds, ordered [survival_adult, reproduction, capacity, survival_juv] -- survival_juv is APPENDED, so w_env[:,0..2] keeps its meaning for positional readers. See docs/PRIORS.md#manifold-prior.
population_model._amplitude_comment: GP AMPLITUDE, one per manifold: w_scale_j = softplus(Normal(amplitude_loc_j, amplitude_scale_j)), so Var(beta_j) = w_scale_j^2 and H_j is a GP conditional on it. See docs/PRIORS.md#gp-amplitude.
population_model._k_range_comment: REPORTING threshold only -- not an active constraint. K is softplus(alpha_k + gamma_k*H_k + trend) with nothing bounding it below, so a collapse is meant to be VISIBLE in metrics.json:k_range rather than hidden by a clamp. 24x is +/-2 log SD of the observed occupied-cell spread (log sd 1.592, from scripts/diagnostics/bbs_abundance_quantiles.py), i.e. the fold range the data actually show; a realized range well beyond it means K is being used to explain absence that should be explained by lambda < 1.
population_model._k_trend_comment: Continental smooth time trend on K's pre-softplus argument, time-centered so alpha_k keeps the level. A SAFETY VALVE AND FAILURE DIAGNOSTIC, not a modeled mechanism. See docs/PRIORS.md#k-trend.

disease_prior._severity_comment: DENSITY-DEPENDENT severity: a Hill function of local carrying capacity, because epidemics need hosts. See docs/PRIORS.md#disease-severity.
disease_prior._ceiling_comment: severity_ceiling is now LOAD-BEARING FOR IDENTIFIABILITY, not merely a bound on plausibility. K = K_base*(1 - severity(K_base)*...) must be monotone in K_base, or two different habitat qualities map to the same realized capacity. At 0.5 monotonicity holds for every n tested (min dK/dK_base = 0.100 at n=5); at 0.7 it BREAKS (slope -0.26). It also happens to match the documented ~50-60% decline, which was measured in the dense eastern populations -- exactly where this parameterization applies it. Do not raise it above ~0.6 without re-checking monotonicity.
disease_prior._mu_comment: Logit of the MODIFIER on density-dependent severity, not of the removed fraction itself: severity = severity_ceiling * sigmoid(mu + ...) * hill(K_base). See docs/PRIORS.md#disease-severity-modifier.
disease_prior._field_comment: sev_field_budget is the total regional deviation the severity field may add on the logit scale (distributed as budget/sqrt(n) per coefficient); 0.5 comfortably reaches west ~25-30% vs east ~60%. lag0_scale/lag_field_budget are YEARS of onset-timing slack, continental and regional respectively -- the arrival map is a hand-built smoothed reconstruction, so its timing is coarse both overall and regionally.
disease_prior._late_comment: Severity coefficient on decades since the EPIDEMIC'S OWN start (disease_start_year=1993), not since any cell's local arrival. See docs/PRIORS.md#disease-late-era.
disease_prior._native_comment: NATIVE-LINEAGE severity suppression, on the same dimensionless core/margin shape that seeds 1902 abundance. See docs/PRIORS.md#disease-native-resistance.
disease_prior._recovery_comment: Slowly increasing resilience after local arrival: the hit decays toward severity*(1-recovery_fraction) with an e-folding time of recovery_tau years. recovery_logit_loc=-0.5 -> prior median ~38% of the hit eventually recovered, spanning 0 to ~90%.

map._comment: Continuation begins under tight priors and progressively relaxes them at absolute optimizer steps. The standard/full run uses 300 tight + 300 intermediate + 1200 nominal-prior steps (1800 total). Boundaries are independent of TOTAL_STEPS so extending/resuming a run cannot move backward. lr_decay_steps is likewise fixed across extensions; after step 900 optimization continues at the schedule's minimum learning rate.
map._log_every_comment: Steps between '[map] step ...' progress lines on stdout (the SLURM .o log). tqdm also carries the loss, but it writes a single carriage-return-rewritten line to stderr, so a running fit's loss trajectory is otherwise invisible in the log. Override per-run with HOUFIN_MAP_LOG_EVERY; 0 disables. A profile may set its own value.

quick90._comment: Short development fit: 100 tight, 100 intermediate and 200 nominal-prior steps (400 total, per prior_relaxation below). The learning-rate decay reaches its minimum at step 300 (lr_decay_steps) and stays there for the final 100. This changes optimization only, not the final MAP objective. The name is historical -- it was a 900-step, ~90-minute profile before the schedule was compressed; it is now much shorter.

runtime._comment: Production JAX jobs require a GPU and explicitly place model inputs in VRAM. HOUFIN_MODEL_INPUT_RESIDENCY=host is experimental: lax.scan is not a true differentiable host-streaming mechanism. SLURM wrappers record nvidia-smi VRAM/utilization plus host MemAvailable/SwapFree every 30 seconds (the interval is the second positional argument to start_gpu_monitor in the .slurm files, not a config key).
